verdicts.reason: A drops the SOLSTICE logo; only a stray dot is left at the far left, so the brand is gone. Its CTA 'Shop the Summer Line' also wraps awkwardly onto two lines and sits pressed against the right edge. B keeps the sun mark and wordmark, which is slightly better, but they are shrunk to an illegible speck crammed against the left edge, and B has the same two-line CTA problem on the right.
